title: Crispy Air Fryer Bang Bang Chicken Tenders
description: Cornflake-crusted air fryer chicken breast strips dipped in a Greek yogurt bang bang sauce, tuned for higher protein density.
instructions: Slice 450g chicken breast into 9 strips. Season with salt, pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, and 1 tsp onion powder.
Set up 2 bowls: whisk 1 egg in the first, add 50g crushed cornflakes to the second.
Dip each strip into the egg, then coat with the 50g crushed cornflakes.
Arrange the coated strips in the air fryer basket and mist with 10 sprays cooking oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (internal temp 165°F/74°C).
While the chicken cooks, whisk together 100g Greek yogurt, 15g sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp sriracha, and 10g maple syrup in a small bowl to make the bang bang sauce.
Dip or drizzle the strips in the bang bang sauce and serve immediately.
notes: Protein density is ~13g/100kcal — still short of the 16g/100kcal target since the breaded format has a structural ceiling.
